newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed, five wounded in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed, five wounded in Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was killed and five wounded on Thursday night in a fierce clash with Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

Later, Israeli helicopters struck twice onto Hizbollah bases just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. In a separate air raid, an Israeli helicopter rocketed a Lebanese army checkpoint north of the zone.

The clash between Israeli troops and Hizbollah guerrillas occurred as the Israelis got caught in a guerrilla ambush in ad-Dahr Daidaba south of the Syrian-controlled Bekaa valley, two km (one mile) north of the zone.
In Beirut, Hizbollah said its guerrills ambushed the group as they attempted to infiltrate outside the zone.
The militia sources said two Hizbollah guerrillas were killed in the clash but a Hizbollah spokesman in Beirut denied the reports.
Lebanese security sources gave no immediate word on casualties in the air raids but said a Lebanese army vehicle was burned by an Israeli rocket.
